note: Needs Card AND ALSO is of Legality [has LegalityFormat: 'commander'] has LegalityStatus: 'Legal', restricted to cards with unknown power (power = '*' OR power absent). Two separate problems block this: (1) the LegalityHasUu fact type's join is broken in this model/database -- 'THE COUNT OF Legality [has Card has CardId]' (a forced real join, not the lazy not-null shortcut) returns 0 out of 427907 Legality rows, i.e. Card and Legality never actually join on this data (looks like the model wired the join to cards.id instead of cards.uuid, which is what card_games' legalities.uuid really references). Same problem hits ForeignData and Ruling. (2) Independently, the 'power is null or power = star' condition needs BUT NOT ... OR OTHERWISE, and this compiler cannot combine that union with more than one other AND ALSO branch: it either fails to compile ('cannot compile: node n10 has no anchor') or, when it does compile, the OR OTHERWISE branch is scoped to the whole query rather than ANDed with the other conditions, giving wrong (too broad) results. Verified both failure modes directly with ./try. No query I could construct is both correct and executes non-empty rows.
